en: <Color:255,200,200,255>So you know, I'm super into guys who are total studs! Even a cool attitude and loads of money can't save a guy who's lacking in looks.<Color:Default>
I'm safe, then. I know I look good.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Uh, you're pretty hot and all, Kiryu-san, but maybe you shouldn't say it that way? Guys who think they're all that put me off, you know?<Color:Default>
So a guy has to be humble, even if they know they're hot.
Guess I'm out of luck. I'm way too old.
<Color:255,200,200,255>What are you talking about? You are ab-so-lutely a stud, Kiryu-san! One hundred percent my type!<Color:Default>
I thought only younger guys qualified for stud status.
Not at all! Heck, a dog or a cat could even be a stud, assuming they looked cool enough.<Color:Default>
That doesn't really make sense.
More to a guy than looks. Shouldn't you have learned that a long time ago?
<Color:255,200,200,255>Hey, it's normal to want that! If a guy has a bad attitude and no money, then I won't even bother.<Color:Default>
I guess that makes sense, when you put it that way.
<Color:255,200,200,255>That's why I looove young, hot pop stars! I go to a ton of musicals and shows where hot guys take the stage.<Color:Default>
That seems like all the rage right now. I hear guys go to a lot of meet-and-greets with female pop stars these days, too.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Are you into that sort of thing by any chance, Kiryu-san?<Color:Default>
Well, I do make sure to catch the Princess League whenever it comes on.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Whoa, really? Isn't that kinda creepy at your age, though? You're  not some pedo, are you?<Color:Default>
Hm. If you didn't know me well enough, I suppose that might give you the wrong impression.
No. I see that sort of thing on TV now and then, but I'm not some obsessed otaku.
<Color:255,200,200,255>I hope not! If I had a boyfriend like that, I'd freak out.<Color:Default>
It's important not to lose perspective with that kind of stuff.
There are good guys around here, too. A pop star isn't going to date some random groupie, after all.
<Color:255,200,200,255>It's not about dating them! I'm not a fan with delusions of scoring a boyfriend.<Color:Default>
Where's your sense of humor? I thought hoping for a shot at romance with a pop star was part of the fun.
<Color:255,200,200,255>That reminds me! One of my favorite hot celebs came to the club the other day! I was so shocked to find out he was into this sort of thing.<Color:Default>
Lucky you. I bet as a fan, you were blown away by getting to meet a famous star you idolize.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Yeah, but he's got a really clean image, and in interviews he said he doesn't drink or smoke. Except he totally did when he was here.<Color:Default>
So he was lying in the interviews?
<Color:255,200,200,255>He also talked different, and he gave off this super mean vibe. It was kind of a shock, actually.<Color:Default>
Looks can be deceiving. It's not about what's on the outside. It's what's inside that counts.
<Color:255,200,200,255>I guess so. Maybe when it comes to hot guys, I should be content with just looking.<Color:Default>
Yeah. If you're dating, it's a different story.
Don't be like that. Celebrities have their own lives behind the scenes. Let them do what they want when they're on their own time.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Yeah, that's why I'm not disillusioned or anything. I guess it is what it is.<Color:Default>
It's great if you can always be yourself, but you can't really expect that from celebrities.
What a letdown. A pop star coming to a cabaret club would ruin my image of him.
You can't let yourself idealize pop stars, Kiryu-san. Lots of people who become famous like that have their unsavory sides as well.<Color:Default>
Oh yeah? Do you think all of their fans support them with that sort of thing in mind?
<Color:255,200,200,255>Well, sure! Part of being a fan is ignoring all that and letting yourself buy into their image.<Color:Default>
So, it's an elaborate deception that goes both ways. Maybe dreams are more like that than I realized.
That's not true. There has to be plenty of those in the entertainment industry who are actually good, hard-working people in their daily lives.
<Color:255,200,200,255>But what if it only seems that way and it's all just an act? You can't really trust a performer.<Color:Default>
Man, that's cynical. I guess dreams really are nothing more than a fantasy.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Huh? But Kiryu-san, weren't you just saying how good-looking you knew you were?<Color:Default>
Oh, uh, I guess so.
<Color:255,200,200,255>You're right⑬looks can be deceiving. Especially when you keep changing your story.<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>So, I feel like I'd like to date some really hot guy, but I never think about actually getting married or having kids with them.<Color:Default>
You don't want to get married? I guess there are lots of people who prefer single life.
<Color:255,200,200,255>No, it's not that, exactly. I just don't want to do anything naughty with a guy. Even the thought of kissing weirds me out.<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>Why? I don't know. It just seems... gross somehow.<Color:Default>
Hm. Maybe you're a germaphobe?
Do you not like guys?
<Color:255,200,200,255>It's not that. I enjoy being with someone I like just fine, but anything more than that is a big no-no in my book.<Color:Default>
I don't really get that.
Kiryu-san, do you want to do those sorts of things with your girlfriends?<Color:Default>
Of course. Men are sexual creatures, after all.
Yeah, I guess so. I think that's normal.<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>That's why whenever I date someone, I tell them if they want to do stuff like that, date another girl. Or get your action at a massage parlor.<Color:Default>
That makes sense. You don't want to date guys who don't agree to those conditions.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Yeah. And I just want to smack guys who still try to press the issue afterwards.<Color:Default>
That sounds natural.
You shouldn't be dating. It's going to be hard to find someone willing to go out with you while being okay with your terms.
<Color:255,200,200,255>I don't think so. Can't someone be happy simply being with someone else?<Color:Default>
I know what you mean. I lived with a woman for nearly six months, and we never did anything.
But we still felt a mutual fondness for each other, so I don't feel bad about any of it.
<Color:255,200,200,255>See? That's the kind of relationship I want! Maybe you'd be a good fit for me, Kiryu-san!<Color:Default>
Hey, just leave it to me.
There's something missing. It's not puppy love. Grown-up love requires something more.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Well, if someone wants that, they can look for it from someone else. I just don't need that sort of thing.<Color:Default>
I'll have to keep that in mind.
What if he's good at it? You're probably saying that because you only have experience with lousy partners.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Don't you even go there! Sex isn't a subject I want to get into! Ugh, I didn't think you'd push the issue like this, Kiryu-san.<Color:Default>
Not really. True love stands on its own, unrelated to any sexual desires.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Right! There are plenty of grown-ups who aren't opposed to that sort of thing. Guys who keep trying to bring it around to sex are the worst!<Color:Default>
Guys shouldn't talk like that with girls. That's the sort of thing to save for the fellas.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Do you talk about that sort of thing with your friends?<Color:Default>
Maybe once in a great while.
You should at least be able to talk about it. It's part of your job as a hostess, isn't it?
<Color:255,200,200,255>I guess. I have managed to build up more of a tolerance to it than before.<Color:Default>
Maybe you'll eventually be able to stop worrying about it completely. If you can't, you should probably quit.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Yeah...<Color:Default>
Yeah. And not just my girlfriends. Matters of the heart are different than those of the flesh.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Whoa, you really sound like a total player. Maybe all guys are like that.<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>Hey, guess what? At our next event, I'm going to be a DJ! You should come!<Color:Default>
DJ? I didn't know you were into that.
<Color:255,200,200,255>This'll be my first time. I love being up in front of a crowd like that.<Color:Default>
Really? Then you should be a good fit. Maybe in the future you could try to go pro.
<Color:255,200,200,255>No way! This is a phase I'm in, that's all.<Color:Default>
I'd never have guessed. You don't look like the club-going type.
<Color:255,200,200,255>I've had the chance to go a lot recently.<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>The DJs at the clubs I've been to have been pretty studly, too. Lots of the ones I've talked to said I should give it a whirl!<Color:Default>
Wait, that's why you got into this?
<Color:255,200,200,255>Sure, why not? That's how it always goes when I want to get into something new.<Color:Default>
Fair enough. Imitating what our parents, people we like, or even what we see strangers do often leads to developing a taste for new things.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Yeah! When I see someone who's good at something I always think, "Hey, I wanna try that too!" It happens all the time, actually.<Color:Default>
Heh. You're very impressionable, aren't you?
Be more serious. Half-hearted reasons like that won't help you to get better, or even stick with it.
<Color:255,200,200,255>I don't really care about that too much. It isn't like I'm expecting it to pay the bills.<Color:Default>
Then what are you expecting?
<Color:255,200,200,255>Not much, really. I'm just doing it to make friends, not because I'm thinking of seriously getting into it.<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>Lots of times, I'll lose interest in those people and then disengage from the scene entirely.<Color:Default>
You lose interest easily. That's the flip side of women who get fired up quickly.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Yeah! When I lose interest in someone, I almost start to dislike them.<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>So even if I wanted to keep going with something, I'd have no choice but to quit, because that person I don't like anymore would still be involved.<Color:Default>
Relationships sure are complicated.
Find something to be passionate about. You'll never forge lasting connections with people if you're so noncommittal.
<Color:255,200,200,255>That's sorta the point.<Color:Default>
Wait, what's the point, exactly?
<Color:255,200,200,255>If I settle down in any one place for too long, it'll become too familiar, just like work. Even special events have become boring.<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>I'd rather keep throwing myself into new things instead!<Color:Default>
You're constantly searching for something new. Might not be a bad way to live.
Always? This has happened before?
<Color:255,200,200,255>Oh yeah. I was into a dancer this one time, so I tried out dancing. And Noodles got me to join a band before that. I do all sorts of stuff!<Color:Default>
You've very talented. You can do all that stuff?
<Color:255,200,200,255>Yeah. I'm a show-off and I like people to pay attention to me, so when I decide to do something, I go at it whole hog and practice till it's perfect.<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>Thanks to that, I've met a ton of people. But in any other case, dealing with people and relationships is a huge pain for me.<Color:Default>
Could you give an example?
<Color:255,200,200,255>Oh, you know, stuff like who likes who and all that. I wish I could simply enjoy myself, but some kind of drama always comes up and gets annoying.<Color:Default>
I wish everyone could be happy. But it's never that easy.
Better than being alone. The occasional hardship spices up your life.
<Color:255,200,200,255>I guess so. I hate being alone too, which is why I go to places where lots of people gather.<Color:Default>
But beyond that you don't need the added hassle? That is very like you.
You do too much. It sounds like you get bored right away and then try something new. Why not stick with something a bit longer?
